data.title: Karman Holdings Initiated at Buy as Analyst Sees Multi‑Year Growth from Accelerating Missile Procurement Cycle
data.description:
William Blair analyst Louie DiPalma has maintained their bullish stance on KRMN stock, giving a Buy rating on September 27.

Louie DiPalma has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to the accelerating missile procurement cycle. He sees Karman Holdings Inc. positioned to benefit from the unprecedented wave of roughly $185 billion in missile contract awards aimed at rebuilding inventories and preparing for future engagements, which should translate into multi‑year revenue visibility for the company.

Louie DiPalma’s rating is based on the expectation that policy initiatives to substantially expand production of key weapons systems will support sustained demand for Karman’s offerings. With major production‑related contracts now locked in, he believes Karman can capture a meaningful share of this growth, underpinning attractive earnings potential and justifying a Buy recommendation on KRMN.

data.title: Alight Maintained at Buy as Abett Acquisition Strengthens Data Capabilities; $22 Price Target Reaffirmed
data.description:
Alight, the Technology sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst today. Analyst Peter Heckmann from D.A. Davidson maintained a Buy rating on the stock and has a $22.00 price target.

Peter Heckmann has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Alight’s strategic acquisition of Abett. He sees the deal as significantly strengthening Alight’s ability to securely aggregate and interpret vast amounts of healthcare and benefits data, improving decision-making for both employers and employees while supporting the company’s long-term value proposition.

Heckmann also notes that integrating Abett’s data engine into Alight’s large existing client base enhances benefits intelligence, employee engagement, and cost optimization across millions of covered lives. Although Abett’s near-term revenue impact appears modest and the purchase price relatively small, he believes the transaction meaningfully improves Alight’s competitive positioning, justifying the maintained Buy rating and unchanged $22 price target.

data.title: Più Medical: Analyst Reiterates Buy Rating and €8.2 Target Price on Strengthening Business Model and Profitable M&A Momentum
data.description:
Analyst Mathias Paladino of TP ICAP MIDCAP maintained a Buy rating on Piu Medical S.P.A., with a price target of €8.20.

Mathias Paladino has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors pointing to a strengthening business model at Più Medical. The company’s pharmacy network is posting robust pro forma growth, with rising revenue and EBITDA at store level, while recent acquisitions like Formaggia are already adding meaningful and profitable contributions despite ongoing integration and development spending.

This momentum is supported by a solid financial position and a clear strategy of disciplined M&A, operational integration and expansion into new healthcare verticals, which should unlock operating leverage over time. Although near-term margins are weighed down by ramp-up and corporate costs, Paladino views these as investments that will enable EBITDA to grow faster than the cost base, underpinning his valuation, target price of €8.2 and reiterated Buy recommendation on PMED.
